content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-70. - Use of accrued interest and premium.
content.summary:
Any accrued interest and any premium shall be applied to the payment of the interest
               on or the principal of the bonds or of both interest and principal.
(Code 1981, § 27-71; Ord. No. 551, § 25(F), 5-14-1964)
